description: This Java source file defines the UtilCacheEvents class, which contains static methods for handling web events related to cache operations such as removing elements, clearing caches, and updating cache settings within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilCacheEvents
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for cache-related web event handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: removeElementEvent
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to remove a specific element from a named cache, identified by its index.

methods.name: clearEvent
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to clear a specific named cache.

methods.name: clearAllEvent
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to clear all caches.

methods.name: clearSelectedCachesEvent
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to clear multiple selected caches based on form input.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to update cache settings such as max in memory, expire time, and soft reference usage.
